technical.summary: Short-term momentum is overbought with bullish technicals, but price remains below key moving averages (50/200) and Ichimoku cloud, signaling weak intermediate trend structure and limiting swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: ADBE shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 55 days.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buy signal from junior member combined with extreme market fear (27/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and small transaction sizes limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (324.0) indicates extreme market stress, and credit conditions are deteriorating; earnings in 55 days adds moderate event risk but secondary to acute systemic conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term RSI/Stoch overbought with supertrend bullish and price near support (298.08) offers contrarian mean-reversion setup in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis).
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all key moving averages (EMA20/50, SMA50/200), Ichimoku cloud, with negative momentum (CMF, AO), zero fundamental conviction, earnings risk in 55 days, and macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, credit stress) make this a high-risk, low-probability swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Price at support with overbought short-term momentum offers contrarian setup, but macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 324, credit stress) and price trapped below all key moving averages eliminate swing probability.
decision.primary_risk: Macro recession signals and earnings event in 55 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs short-term mean-reversion opportunity.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ADBE with 27 existing IT positions (10.9% sector concentration); skip reduces concentration risk and preserves capital in crisis environment.
